name: KKB
recent: KKB Engineering 的子公司在一项仲裁中赢得约 RM49.8 million 的裁决。董事和大股东在9月有多笔股权变动，均为增持。最新季度营收环比和同比均增长，净利同比上升。
notable: 子公司赢得针对 Shapadu Energy 的约 RM49.8 million 仲裁裁决。
董事和大股东在9月15日和17日增持股份。
risks: 公司仍有一项重大诉讼公告（2026-10-26）。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 RM64.9 million，环比增长164.0%，同比增长16.9%；净利为 RM9.19 million，同比增长29.4%，净利率14.1%。

recent_en: KKB Engineering's subsidiary won an arbitration award of about RM49.8 million. Directors and substantial shareholders had several shareholding changes in September, all acquisitions. Latest quarter revenue grew both QoQ and YoY, with net profit up YoY.
notable_en: Subsidiary won an arbitration award of about RM49.8 million against Shapadu Energy.
Directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares on 15 and 17 September.
risks_en: The company has an ongoing material litigation announcement (2026-10-26).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM64.9 million, up 164.0% QoQ and 16.9% YoY; net profit was RM9.19 million, up 29.4% YoY, with a net margin of 14.1%.
